documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported its H1 FY26 financial performance, highlighting a 49.08% year-on-year growth in revenue to Rs. 77.77 crores and a 46.66% increase in PAT to Rs. 7.20 crores. Management discussed operational updates including product mix, expansion into new categories like soya chunks and puja articles, distribution networks across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and low initial utilization in the newly launched edible oil division. The company remains focused on operational efficiency, working capital management, and expanding its regional product portfolio rather than immediate geographical expansion.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margins and oil revenue pick-up.
guidance.quote: So, H2 will be better in the Oil. So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach up to 30% utilization in the oil segment in H2.
guidance.quote: I think next financial year, H2 will be utilized almost 30% easily. We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a very good response from the market for the groundnut oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: But we are having very good response from the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Poushtik is designed to meet the growing demand for healthy convenient food choices with an emphasis on nutrition and accessibility.
demand_outlook.quote: Poushtik is our new age digitally-driven vertical. It focuses on online sales offering direct to customer delivery and targeted distribution to local retailers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that atta was introduced to meet growing demand for fresh stone ground flour.
demand_outlook.quote: By 2021, we had expanded our spices portfolio and in 2022 we introduced our chakki atta to growing demand for fresh stone ground flour.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles and devotional goods in January.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are in the testing mode for soya chunks and will plan for capacities and capex after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are testing, actually we are in the testing mode for the Soya Chunks. So, once after the 2 quarters only, we can go for the capacities and what will be the CAPEX required.

capex_expansion.claim: Export market expansion into regions like the Middle East, Singapore, and the US is planned for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new edible oil production plant that started commercial production on 10th May 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: we launched our edible oil on 10th May 2025 and it started its commercial production on 10th May 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: For spices and masalas, the installed capacity is 3,600 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The oil plant has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY26, the company reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that media channel advertisements cost around Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 lakhs monthly.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05%.
Cart value for spices and masalas is between 30% to 35% with a margin of 35% to 40%.
margins_costs.quote: Like for spices and masalas, cart value is between Page 4 of 16 Srivari Spices and Foods Limited June 11, 2025 30% to 35% wherein with a margin of 35% to 40% and pulses and grains and whole space cart value will be 40% to 45% and margins with 30% to 35%.

margins_costs.claim: Cart value for oil and ghee and other products is 15% to 20% with margins of 18% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for spices is 3,600 tons with a utilization of 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there are currently no plans for raising equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings. That was one of the main reasons.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they will rely on bank debt if needed for expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be going for the debt as of now. If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: The entire rights issue amount was utilized for specified purposes without any deviation as disclosed in the letter of offer.
capital_allocation.quote: we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

capital_allocation.claim: The objects of the rights issue included INR8.64 crores for the oil plant, INR1.90 crores for repayment of unsecured loans, INR10 crores for working capital, and INR4 crores for general corporate purpose.
capital_allocation.quote: our main objects of the rights issue was to for the oil plant, which is around INR8.64 crores, sorry, 864.02 lakhs, that is INR8 crores 64 lakhs change and repayment of unsecured loans, which is about INR1.90 crores and for working capital requirement, it is around INR10 crores and for general corporate purpose, it is around INR4 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that entering new states like Maharashtra involves a tough time and higher advertising costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even we are expanding the geographical also, but as we launched in the Maharashtra, so we are having a very tough time in the Maharashtra. So, we are not getting that much of revenue speed, what we wanted.

risks_headwinds.claim: An overdraft taken on the last day of September contributed to an increase in short-term borrowings.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, mainly there was one OD came on the last day of September. So, that contributed so much towards short-term borrowings. That was one of the main reasons.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that growth targets were not reached last year due to the challenges of a new setup and a delay in the rights issue.
risks_headwinds.quote: as we have in the earlier this investor's meet we have committed some growth percentage and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup. It's a huge setup and second thing was the delay in the rights.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch the puja and devotional products vertical in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to evaluate export market expansion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely. But in FY '27. Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
management_commitments.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all the oil products will be placed in the complete marketplaces by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Poushtik products will be launched at the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: soon it will be announced in this month end.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
